decision_summary: Proceed with QIF v0.6.6 Approval Persistence Policy.
rationale: Current HITL patterns persist approval and rejection decisions across paused/resumed runs. QIF needs explicit persistence scope, expiry, identity boundary, and revocation conditions before approval convenience becomes hidden authority.
recommendation: Release v0.6.6 after npm test and repository hygiene checks pass.
target_audience: QIF maintainers and AI agents using Action Quality Contract
expected_user_reaction: They can see when sticky approval is allowed and when it expires.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add approvalPersistencePolicies to action-quality-contract schema, example, verifier, fixtures, docs, and release notes.
organization_change_recommendations: Keep verifier boundary explicit: persistence policy structure is not approval correctness or runtime enforcement.
